N14-BUNDLE-001.why_retired: one identity came to name TWO different manifests, which is what the contract forbids: dd2b9c26... (the invalid cut) and ecd95c69... (a valid but identity-defective cut). Neither was dispatched.

N14-BUNDLE-002.why_retired: presented to a review seat and STOPPED TWICE on an execution-environment delivery failure, never on its content: the seat verified 130/130 payload hashes and then could not start Python. Retired when the review runtime became part of the delivery identity, which changes ENVIRONMENT.json and the manifest.

N14-BUNDLE-003.why_retired: delivered, and STOPPED pre-substantively on a WRITE-PERMISSION failure: the runner created its scratch directory at the SEALED BUNDLE ROOT and the review seat got WinError 5 there, before the guard was armed. Correct of the seat -- a sealed input directory has no business being writable. Retired because moving scratch onto the reviewer surface changes the runner and the guard, hence the bytes.

N14-BUNDLE-004.why_retired: NEVER DISPATCHED, retired by the builder's own identity discipline. Its write surfaces were declared in the build profile but not in the MANIFEST, so the reviewer could not see where ephemeral scratch appears or that it is not their artefact. Its digest had already been recorded in ops/DECISIONS.md, and re-cutting under the same id would make a committed citation resolve to a different manifest -- the exact defect DEC-CRB-ID-2 exists to prevent. So the id is retired instead.

tests_deselected_reasons.tests/test_no_public_mc_function_is_unre: A REPOSITORY-WIDE static scan: it walks src/ and tests/ and reports any public mc/ function nothing references. An exact-tree bundle carries a SUBSET of tests/, so callers that live outside the payload are absent and the scan reports false orphans -- measured, it did. The property is about the whole repository and a subset tree cannot establish it either way. Reading the file is still worthwhile and it is in tree/.

tests_not_collected_reasons.tests/test_mc_supplement_paths_battery.p: MODULE-LEVEL, so no deselection can reach it: at its line 321 the file reads C:\Users\Aaron\quant-data\itsf-registry\ops\TRIAL_REGISTRY.md while being imported. src/itsf/mc/registry_boundary.py:75 freezes that root as an exact string and its own comment records the ruling -- 'FROZEN AND NOT OVERRIDABLE FROM THE ENVIRONMENT, as the route requires' (migration Route A, step S6). There is no seam, the frozen implementation may not be edited, and the path exists on no machine but the Owner's, so the read cannot be satisfied inside a sealed bundle by any means. MEASURED CONSEQUENCE: coverage of src/itsf/mc was taken over the full local selection and again over the bundle's selection. With probes/test_o13_path_refusals.py present the two are IDENTICAL -- zero statements lost. The battery's own docstring states the read's purpose: 'opened READ-ONLY, once, at import, purely to learn the highest sequence'.

write_surfaces.bytecode: sys.dont_write_bytecode is set by the runner itself, so the sealed tree stays clean even if a reviewer invokes run_bundle_tests.py directly without the launcher's -B.
write_surfaces.ephemeral_scratch: return/.scratch/ -- a DOT directory inside the reviewer surface, so it can never be mistaken for a reviewer artefact. pytest's basetemp is pinned into it; TMP/TEMP/TMPDIR and tempfile.tempdir all point at it.
write_surfaces.reviewer_return: return/ -- the contract's existing writable surface. REVIEW.md already sends INITIAL_FINDINGS.md, FREEZE.json and ATTESTATION.md there, and the review seat has demonstrably written into it three times across two deliveries.

scratch_lifecycle.after_failure: KEPT for diagnosis and labelled with EPHEMERAL_DO_NOT_READ_AS_EVIDENCE.txt
scratch_lifecycle.after_success: REMOVED by the runner, walking and unlinking (permitted under return/) rather than rmtree
scratch_lifecycle.before: removed if present, then created empty -- done BEFORE the guard arms, because shutil.rmtree is one of the escape classes the guard denies outright
scratch_lifecycle.during: the only place temporary files may exist

write_surfaces.sealed_payload: READ-ONLY to review execution. The guard now denies every mutating event inside the bundle that is not under return/, so tree/, authority/, probes/, environment/, MANIFEST.json and the runner itself cannot be written by the run that reads them.
